offers_products.reason: Offers an online insurance marketplace and lead matching, not goods or licensed software.

offers_services.reason: Matches shoppers with insurers and agents, delivering customer acquisition and quote comparison for carriers and agents.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Households use the free auto and home insurance quote comparison and choose which providers to contact.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance carriers and local agents are the paying customers for consumer leads and customer acquisition.

recurring_revenue.reason: Carriers and agents repeatedly buy leads and customer acquisition from the platform, though without fixed subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Carriers' marketing spend on customer acquisition can be cut or paused when conditions weaken.

big_ticket.reason: Leads and quote requests are small, frequent purchases for carriers and agents; consumers pay nothing.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the data, AI matching technology and online marketplace, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main paying customers are large insurance carriers, alongside thousands of local agents.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light online platform built on technology and marketing, with no plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Consumers use it free; carriers and agents pay, so the consumer answer rests on who chooses and receives the service.
